s4_clarification.reason: Before observing S4 inputs or outcomes, replace the card's generic unimplemented bordered-nullspace label with an explicit range/nullspace two-step iteration whose projected second-derivative operator and applicability assumptions can be tested independently. This is a new development candidate, not a reinterpretation of S3.

claim_boundary.allowed_claim: A development-only test of one nullspace two-step refiner for frozen C2 black-box endpoints analytically known to be deflation-one singular, with explicit route, budget, semantic and counterexample gates.
forbidden_claims: success on arbitrary multiplicity or higher deflation depth
a result about unopened locked inputs

literature.use: Approximate left/right nullspaces from one nearby Jacobian can regularize a generalized-regular singularity, including higher nullity, only under the paper's stated local conditions.

For a sufficiently close approximation to an isolated deflation-one zero of a square analytic system, a retained-range SVD correction followed by a projected Hessian/nullspace correction converges quadratically.
Numerical rank and singular subspaces near a transition require explicit stability controls rather than one cutoff.

variants.implementation: unchanged frozen S1 implementation and global work accounting

At each outer iteration, form a charged C2 central-difference Jacobian, split retained and numerical-null subspaces by SVD, apply the retained-range correction, then solve the projected nullspace correction using charged mixed second directional differences of the canonical residual.
Separately coded analytic Jacobian and Hessian-direction version of the same mathematical two-step map; it may share only work-ledger and canonical semantic replay types with the candidate.

candidate_map.range_step: With J=U1*Sigma1*V1'+U2*Sigma2*V2', set x_range=x-V1*inv(Sigma1)*U1'*F(x), solving without an explicit inverse.
candidate_map.null_probe: Choose v=V2*c from frozen nonzero counter-derived coefficients c normalized in two-norm; coefficients cannot depend on family, Gold, or target.
candidate_map.projected_operator: B_ij is U2[:,i]'*D2F(x_range)[v,V2[:,j]]. The C2 candidate estimates each mixed directional derivative directly from four canonical residual calls at x_range plus/minus h*v plus/minus k*V2[:,j]; the analytic control evaluates it independently.
candidate_map.null_step: Solve B*delta=-U2'*J(x_range)*v and set x_next=x_range+V2*delta. Rank-deficient, nonfinite or ill-conditioned B returns typed unknown.
candidate_map.iteration_unit: One globally charged trajectory iteration includes the complete range and nullspace steps; a failed probe still consumes its callbacks and iteration.
candidate_map.final_truth: Only unchanged canonical semantic replay and separately typed numerical-root evidence may pass the experimental promotion gate.

allowed_inputs: rank, condition, singular-value gaps and principal angles at frozen precisions and radii
routing_contract.trigger: C2 square system with at least one retained regular direction; primary endpoint below the strict numerical residual goal; the same nonzero nullity selected by a singular-value gap ratio at most 1e-6 at 128 and 256 bits and radius multipliers 1 and 0.5; corresponding left/right nullspace principal-angle sine at most 1e-6; projected operator full rank at both precisions.
routing_contract.fail_closed: Capability loss, rank or nullspace instability, projected-operator rank loss, guard/domain/branch failure, nonfinite arithmetic, a hard-budget stop, or confirmation disagreement returns typed unknown without S1 fallback presented as S4 evidence.

cubic and quartic null directions whose projected Hessian operator is singular
small residual but analytically inconsistent systems
separated regular fold roots above and below the S3 metamorphic stress scale

rank, nullity, left/right principal-angle and projected-operator gates pass at both route precisions
